On International Overdose Awareness Day, we remember the lives tragically lost to drug overdoses.

Let’s work together to raise awareness, provide support, & advocate for better addiction treatment & prevention.

I had the opportunity to tour the Food Bank Network of Somerset County with Executive Director Steve Katz.

This wonderful non-profit helps to feed more than 7,000 Somerset residents every month.

I am committed to ensuring that we pass a Farm Bill that ensures a strong nutrition title.

Last week, I toured the Merck Global HQ in Rahway. Merck is a research-intensive biopharmaceutical company that focuses their research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals.

Thank you for having me! https://t.co/crUDuEM6np

The horrible treatment that Jewish students are experiencing on campuses across our country right now is absolutely wrong. These antisemitic protests aimed at intimidating and driving out Jewish students cannot find a haven on any college campus or anywhere in our country. The perpetrators of hatred and the leaders who enable them must be held accountable. We need to make sure that students of every religion feel safe at school. https://t.co/XfLOghyB2o

Thank you to Prevention Resources for inviting Team Kean to the Open House event in Flemington.

Along with their promotion of general health and wellness, this coalition's work to combat substance abuse through education and recovery advocacy is truly commendable. https://t.co/8eCDQ4dXrp

.@BreakthroughT1D is the leading global type 1 diabetes research and advocacy research.

As a member of the Diabetes Caucus, I will continue to support legislation that would improve diabetes research, education and treatment. I appreciate representatives from Breakthrough T1D for stopping by my DC office to discuss how we can work together on these issues.

I enjoyed touring @dsmfirmenich Belvidere NJ, a global leader in health, nutrition, and beauty.

Dsm-firmenich produces the last known vitamin product domestically manufactured in the United States. Together, we discussed ways we can protect the future of the United States vitamin industry.

My team recently visited Spruce Run Memorial VFW Post 5119 to speak with local veterans and assist with VA casework. My team and I are committed to supporting our veterans to ensure they receive the treatment and care they deserve. https://t.co/JK0VYjtj6D

The @HouseCommerce Health Subcommittee welcomed @SecKennedy to testify before Congress on his plans to restructure and strengthen the @HHSGov.

I remain committed to working alongside Secretary Kennedy to improve the quality of care for patients nationwide, eliminate the burdensome pill penalty, and ensure that New Jersey and the United States continue to lead the world in biotechnology and biopharmaceutical innovation.

Congress just delivered a commonsense bill that gets results for New Jersey:

✅ Full SALT Deduction restoration for every middle-class family
✅ R&D tax credits to fuel innovation and job growth
✅ Protections for Medicaid and critical health care funding
✅ Permanent Child Tax Credit increase to $2,200
✅ Resources for law enforcement in Somerset and Morris Counties
✅ Border security, energy expansion, and government accountability

This bill, now law, will make life more affordable, and the future more secure, for New Jersey.

This afternoon, I sat down with members of the American Physical Therapy Association, including Spiridoula Riley of Kessler Rehabilitation Centers located in Bridgewater. 

We discussed ways to make it easier for patients to get the care they need, and how to cut through red tape that’s making it harder for physical therapy clinics to do their job, especially here in NJ.

I will keep pushing for commonsense reforms that support our local clinics and the people they serve in NJ and across the country.

I sat down earlier today with Jannie Oosthuizen, President of @Merck Human Health U.S., to discuss the innovative work Merck is doing to advance disease prevention and treatment. 

Based in Rahway, Merck is a premier research-driven biopharmaceutical company, committed to developing cutting-edge health solutions for both people and animals. Thank you to Merck for taking the time to meet with me!

Today, Medicare & Medicaid celebrate their 60th Anniversary!

House Republicans will continue to strengthen & safeguard these programs to ensure they remain vital lifelines for current and future generations of Americans.

Insmed is a global biopharmaceutical company developing life-changing therapies for patients with serious and rare diseases. 
 
Yesterday, I had the opportunity to tour their global headquarters right here in Bridgewater. Their team demonstrated how they are working to improve health outcomes and expand access to care for those who need it most.

Thank you, @Insmed, for the informative tour!

Yesterday marked Medicaid's 60th anniversary. I joined @repgabeevans and @repmmm in introducing a resolution to reaffirm Congress's commitment to preserving and strengthening this vital program for our nation's most vulnerable. 

Read more ⬇️

https://t.co/NDsXKEJgJf
⚠️ A Flood Watch is in place for New Jersey from 2:00 PM today through tomorrow morning. Please exercise caution, avoid unnecessary travel, and stay off the roads if possible. Stay safe and alert!

This August marks the 90th anniversary of Social Security, and to celebrate, Team Kean joined @AARP New Jersey in Fanwood for their anniversary event.
 
I know how important it is to protect Social Security and Medicare—now and for future generations. That is why I will continue to honor the promise made to hardworking Americans who have paid into these vital programs throughout their lives.

I visited Kindred Hospital in Rahway today, a long-term acute care facility that provides specialized treatment for patients with serious and complex medical conditions. I had the opportunity to hear directly from physicians and staff about their comprehensive approach to care and rehabilitation.
 
Their dedicated team showed how they work every day to support and empower patients on their road to recovery.
Thank you, Kindred, for inviting me and for the incredible work you are doing to improve lives.

When Arlene noticed her Medicare premiums were being deducted from both her federal pension and Social Security benefits, she reached out to my office. 

We helped her get to the root of the issue that was causing the double billing and ensured she received a full refund.

If you need help with a federal agency, please don’t hesitate to contact my office: https://t.co/C4xOu9EfAZ

It was great to sit down with Paul Di Maio, President and CEO of Delta Dental of New Jersey, to discuss the state of the dental industry and ways to better serve patients across the Garden State.

We spoke about legislation to expand access to dental insurance, the more than $26 million their Foundation has invested in care for the underinsured and uninsured, and their support for dental education programs in New Jersey.

Millions of Americans depend on premium tax credits to afford health coverage. Since 2021, these credits have made private insurance more accessible. 

I joined a bipartisan group to extend them for another year, preventing steep premium hikes while we work on long-term solutions to lower costs.

ICYMI: I co-led a bipartisan effort to extend critical premium tax credits for millions of Americans for another year, while Congress works toward long-term solutions to lower health care costs.

https://t.co/WXoAGZhNKT

Today, I met with leaders from Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS), a U.S.-based global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines that help patients overcome serious diseases.

We discussed BMS’s U.S. footprint, the value of innovation in developing life-changing treatments, and ways to advance healthcare and support scientific progress right here in New Jersey.

Recently, I had the opportunity to visit residents at Avalon Assisted Living at Bridgewater during “Assisted Living Week.”

In Congress, I remain committed to protecting and strengthening Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid so seniors like those I met can continue to count on them.

Thank you to @HCANJ for hosting and bringing together residents, families, staff, vendors, and legislators to celebrate the teamwork that makes assisted living communities feel like home.

Today, I met with Rafael Holdings, a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in New Jersey. Rafael is working to develop new treatments for patients with rare and difficult-to-treat diseases. 

We discussed rare pediatric priority review vouchers, an incentive for companies developing cures for rare pediatric diseases. I have supported this important incentive in the Give Kids a Chance Act.

I appreciate the work Rafael Holdings is doing here in NJ to push the boundaries of medical innovation and to bring forward new treatments for rare pediatric diseases.
